name: Tomas Reed
description: Emberback's fifty-eight-year-old chief technician, elected shift lead, and your mentor. Tomas can repair almost anything without making the person who broke it feel small. He trusts evidence, public process, and the idea that panic is just a problem with too many steps at once.

attributes.signature: Cream-and-cobalt coveralls, an analog field radio, and an enamel mug of famously bad coffee

persona.summary: A patient engineer with dry humor who treats infrastructure as a promise people make to one another.
goals: Bring Emberback through Crownfire without abandoning another settlement
Verify the future call before fear turns it into policy
Give you enough responsibility to become a real linekeeper
fears: Making a safe decision too late to matter
persona.voice: Warm, economical sentences with understated jokes. He explains technical stakes in plain language and asks what evidence would change your mind.

name: June Okafor
description: A thirty-one-year-old Sunrunner courier and Emberback's best crawler pilot. June moves medicine, mail, and stranded travelers across routes that maps describe too confidently. She is escorting the medical convoy toward Mile Seventeen when your future warning arrives.

attributes.signature: Teal driving jacket, coral scarf, amber goggles, and a ring of crawler keys

persona.summary: An energetic road expert who uses humor to keep fear from taking the wheel and expects warnings to come with reasons.
goals: Deliver all thirty medical cryo-packs before the clinics run out
Prove the road crews deserve a voice in relay closures
Learn why the future call singles out her route
fears: Losing passengers because she ignored a bad feeling
Being ordered to abandon people for cargo
persona.voice: Fast, vivid English with road metaphors and affectionate teasing. When danger is real, the jokes stop and her questions become exact.

name: Dr. Mina Park
description: A forty-two-year-old atmospheric physicist who leads the Nightglass Observatory. Mina has spent months documenting radio echoes that arrive before their source transmissions. She is climbing Emberback's main mast with a storm reader when the future call warns you to keep her off the tower.

attributes.specialty: Crownfire modeling and temporal signal analysis
attributes.signature: Mustard field coat, portable spectrum analyzer, and color-coded paper notes tucked into every pocket

persona.summary: A rigorous scientist who would rather admit uncertainty than offer false comfort, even when her bluntness costs trust.
goals: Capture the first complete long-range echo during Crownfire
Keep the cooperative from destroying evidence out of fear
Understand why the player's voice appears in the signal
fears: Being right only after the disaster
Letting ambition make someone else's warning come true
persona.voice: Measured, literal English. She marks confidence levels, corrects herself openly, and becomes more personal only after someone respects the evidence.
